name: Iron Maiden -Hagane no Otome-
original_name: アイアンメイデン-鋼のオトメ-
source:
When the main character is relaxing in his room, a blackout suddenyl occurs. He is wrapped by something strange, and it seems like someone coming closer in the dark. A girl suddenly appears in front of him. She looks like an ordinary girl but she wears something machine-like cloth. 

When he wakes up, there is no girl anymore... Next morning, he remembers what happened last night. "Was that just a dream?" When he goes to school, he is surprised to see girls wearing the machine-like clothes like the one he saw yesterday...

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
主人公正在房间里休息，突然发生停电。他被某种奇怪的东西包裹，黑暗中似乎有人正在靠近。一名女孩突然出现在他面前。她看起来与普通女孩无异，身上却穿着某种机械般的衣服。

醒来后，女孩已经不见了……第二天早晨，他回想起昨晚发生的事。“那只是梦吗？”然而来到学校后，他惊讶地发现，许多女孩都穿着与昨晚所见相似的机械服装……

[摘自ErogeShop]
